IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senate Committee on Government Operations & Elections (originally sponsored by Senators Haugen, Fairley and Kline)

Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing registered voters who reside outside of, but own land in, a water district to be elected as a water district commissioner.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to water district commissioner candidates; andadding a new section to chapter 57.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 57.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: If the district has fewer than one hundred residents, and if thefiling period is reopened for a district commissioner under RCW29A.24.171 or 29A.24.181 due to a void in candidacy, any person who isa qualified elector of the state of Washington and who holds title orevidence of title to land in the district may file as a candidate forand serve as a district commissioner.
